svg.title: Hilbert trace and animated 2-D shadow of the Monster shadow system
svg.desc: An animated Hilbert space-filling curve steps through four scales (orders 1 to 4). Order 2 places the 15 Ogg primes in a 4-by-4 grid coloured by how many simple groups each reaches, marking as holes the ten primes with no shadow (7,17,19,23,29,31,41,47,59,71) and the unused 16th cell. Order 3 traces all 51 system nodes (15 primes, 9 groups, 27 shadow parts). Order 4 is the fine narrative manifold. A sampler lens travels each curve. It auto-plays at 2x speed with no interaction (pure SMIL, 12s loop), and a time slider and play/pause button control the timeline.
svg.text: Hilbert Trace of the Monster Shadow System
a 2-D shadow tour · simple → complex · scaling & sampling · Ogg primes → simple groups → shadow parts

g.text: stage 4 · the narrative manifold — the continuum the data embeds into
We begin at the seed: a single Hilbert fold folds a line into the plane.
The 15 Ogg primes land in the 4×4 grid; grey rings are holes — primes with no shadow.
Zoom in: the whole system — primes, then groups, then shadow parts — traced as one path.
At the finest scale the discrete trace dissolves into its narrative manifold.
